intent: Canonical verify.run for the two perf commits; PR #4374 body rewrite pending
progress_summary: Re-scoped PR #4374 after develop landed #4406 (same off-loop projection design). Took develop's implementation and kept this branch to the remaining delta: (1) 8 lifecycle broadcasts now replay the cached rail and defer the authoritative rebuild to #4406's queue, RED/GREEN proven; (2) the worktree reconcile moved from the GUI event loop into the ingest worker, removing a measured 3225ms loop block; (3) cleared develop's clippy 1.95 collapsible_match break so the bin target could be linted. Headed Chromium (isolated HOME, both themes): close-to-list 3.0-8.9ms against a 400ms budget. Open finding: when two Playwright projects run in one invocation, the second sees a 16s silence that correlates with a background git-subprocess storm saturating the async server, not with the GUI event loop - a second, distinct cause that keeps AC-3 from being claimed unconditionally.
